text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're in my office, and Ines Fujin has been talking to someone on the phone for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right. Yes… but Mom, it's what Cassie and Polly want…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just leave it to me… Don't worry, I'll be fine! Talk to you soon!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer! I need a big favor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's almost time for Ines Fujin's race to begin. In the waiting room, a pair of Umamusume twins are perched happily on chairs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Now listen up, you two! Make sure you do what my trainer tells you to while I'm not here!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: We will!
choice_data_list: That's what I like to hear!
That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin's little sisters have come to watch her debut race. That big favor she wanted was for me to look after them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for bringing them both here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, my race overlaps with our mom's hospital visit, but they both kept pleading for the chance to come along and watch me.
choice_data_list: I've got this. You just focus on the race!
I've got this. You just focus on the race!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, okay. I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna head to the paddock. Wish me luck!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: W-wait a sec! The two of us have something we want to show you, sis! Ready, set…

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Spin, spin, and pom-poms!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: Pom-pom! One, two…

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: "Do your best, Big Sis!" Hehe, did you like our cheer dance?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha! That was fantastic! Thanks a bunch, you two!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You've given your big sis a huge energy boost! I'm gonna have to reward you by finishing in first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After saying goodbye to Ines Fujin, I take the twins by their hands and lead them over to the spectator seating.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Wow! So this is Nakayama Racecourse… It looks different on TV, huh?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: There's not that many people, either.
choice_data_list: That's because this is a debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I imagine they're more accustomed to seeing the Nakayama Racecourse filled to the rafters during the Arima Kinen and Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The only people in the stands right now are the race organizers and avid fans. It probably feels different from that big, festival-like vibe.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Huh, I see.
choice_data_list: Were you expecting it to be more exciting?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: No, this is still really great! We get to watch Big Sis race!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: She loves running a whole bunch! And I love seeing her have fun!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Right! So we're gonna cheer extra loud to help her win!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gotta calm these nerves… I can do this! I just have to remember what my trainer taught me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: It figures there aren't many spectators at my first race. I just need to produce results—then my popularity will soar!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I can hear so many different voices.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Voices from the Umamusume I'm competing against, and those from the spectators waiting just beyond the paddock.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale… exhale…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Is that an announcement? They must be using a high quality speaker system. I can hear the sounds of the paddock from here.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I wonder if my number has already appeared on the jumbotron.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This is it—the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Ladies and gentlemen, please join us as we watch these courageous Umamusume take the first steps on their racing journeys!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Twinkle Series, here I come!
